paper.title_en: Finite-temperature Lanczos for anisotropic spin systems using triple-hybrid high-performance computing
paper.abstract_en: Lanczos concepts are often realized on supercomputers. In view of modern architectures of high-performance computing triple-hybrid schemes employing MPI, CPU-openMP as well as GPU-openMP should be utilized. The present article sketches how such a scheme could be utilized in order to meet the demands of the finite-temperature Lanczos method for anisotropic spin systems.
